compose_name.label: naming (compose) stage
compose_name.given: DD path, enriched leaf description, unit, data type, keywords, sibling fields, hybrid and related neighbours, identifier enums and reviewer history, plus an item['ancestor_context'] list of enclosing-structure statements attached by worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py::_enrich_batch_items
compose_name.drops: In names batching mode _compose_batch_body renders sn/generate_name_dd_names, whose per-item block emits item.path, item.description, item.unit and the neighbour blocks but no item.ancestor_context and no item.documentation; the full-mode template sn/generate_name_dd does render the lineage block, so the enclosing text the extraction stage attached never reaches the composer that writes the identity.

attach_guard.label: source-binding (attach) gate
attach_guard.given: The candidate DD path's spelling, the DD unit and the name's unit, the name's spelling (tense, state, shape surface, vector-field axis, geometry representation, hardware device tokens) and the paths already bound to the name
attach_guard.drops: The sources' stated descriptions and operations: the guard has no text parameter, so two sources whose stated operations differ are admitted to one name and the definition stage must then write a single definition from them.

locus_binding.label: locus-token binding and its documentation injection
locus_binding.given: The source's boundary-selection clause as recorded in the packet (psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix, near-separatrix, or LCFS-or-99.x% for a fixed-boundary code) and, at documentation time, the ISN locus registry definition for the name's locus token
locus_binding.drops: The selection. generate_name_system.md binds every plasma-shape parameter to _of_plasma_boundary for the LCFS contour, and locus_context_for injects the registry definition of plasma_boundary, which is categorical: 'the outermost flux surface on which field lines close on themselves'. The documentation stage then states the boundary as that surface.

definition_construction.label: definition (documentation) stage
definition_construction.given: Up to five bound sources' enriched descriptions and DD context, the nearest ancestor lineage (capped at four), sibling family and nearby names
definition_construction.drops: Nothing from the text it receives; it writes one definition and has no obligation to cover every binding's stated operation, and it may substitute a base quantity or a different geometric scope for the named transform.

domain_assignment.label: physics-domain assignment
domain_assignment.given: The name, its description, and a mapping of each source to its DD physics domain
domain_assignment.drops: It resolves a domain for the name as a whole; a name whose sources sit on an equilibrium consumer rather than on the structural quantity it names keeps the consumer's domain.

repair.smallest: Render the enclosing-structure lineage that the extraction stage already attaches: add the item.ancestor_context block from sn/generate_name_dd.md to the per-item block of sn/generate_name_dd_names.md, so the composer sees the clause that states the component, geometric reference or locus and can emit the token or a vocab_gap for it.
repair.note: The prompt already forbids silently generalising a source-stated axis; the defect survives because the text stating the axis is never rendered in names mode.

traced.name: current_of_passive_structure
traced.evidence_excerpt: Current in a set of axisymmetric passive conductors
traced.evidence_text: equilibrium/time_slice/constraints/pf_passive_current: Current in a set of axisymmetric passive conductors Current in a set of axisymmetric passive conductors used as a constraint in MHD equilibrium reconstruction. Stores measured and reconstructed values along with fit quality metrics for comparing to the equilibrium solver solution.
traced.given_segment: the enclosing pf_passive_current statement names the conductor scope the leaf omits
traced.drops_segment: the name keeps the generic 'passive_structure' carrier and the axisymmetric scope is gone

traced.name: gap_at_outboard_midplane
traced.evidence_excerpt: Distance between the inner and outer separatrices
traced.evidence_text: description: Distance between the inner and outer separatrices measured in the major radius direction at the plasma outboard side, at the height of the maximum R of the inner separatrix. Relevant for double-null or near-double-null configurations.
traced.given_segment: the leaf description names the two surfaces whose separation is measured
traced.drops_segment: the name keeps only the midplane locus, so which surfaces are separated is lost

traced.name: inner_radius_of_plasma_filament
traced.evidence_excerpt: Inner radius of an annular cross-section element
traced.evidence_text: description: Inner radius of an annular cross-section element representing a discrete plasma current-carrying filament in the pf_plasma IDS. Defines the inner boundary of the annulus in axisymmetric plasma current distribution modelling.
traced.given_segment: the leaf description states the annular cross-section the radius belongs to
traced.drops_segment: the name reads as the filament's inboard major radius, not a cross-sectional radius

traced.name: rotational_transform
traced.evidence_text: summary/local/r_eff_norm_2_3: Parameters at r_eff_norm = 2/3, where r_eff_norm is the stellarator effective minor radius normalised to its value at the last closed flux surface
traced.given_segment: the enclosing summary/local/r_eff_norm_2_3 node selects the evaluation locus
traced.drops_segment: the name and definition state a general flux-surface transform, with no evaluation locus

repair.smallest: Give the pairing guard the text it is missing: pass the candidate's dd_description and the already-bound sources' descriptions into _is_attachment_consistent and reject a second binding whose stated operation contradicts the first's (the pairing-guard query and attachment_audit._attachment_consistency already select dd_documentation).
repair.note: The definition stage is not the smallest point of repair: it receives the sources but has no rule that it must cover each binding, and correcting a definition cannot unbind a wrong source.

traced.name: plasma_resistance
traced.evidence_excerpt: the ratio of loop voltage to plasma current
traced.evidence_text: description: Plasma electrical resistance (R), the ratio of loop voltage to plasma current, characterizing resistive dissipation in the plasma. Related to plasma temperature and effective charge via Spitzer conductivity.
traced.given_segment: one bound source states the resistance as the loop-voltage-to-current ratio
traced.drops_segment: the stored definition asserts the volume-integrated E.J over Ip^2 power ratio instead

traced.name: toroidal_magnetic_field
traced.evidence_text: documentation: Magnetic field component in direction of sensor normal axis (n) averaged over sensor volume defined by area and length, where n = cos(poloidal_angle)*cos(toroidal_angle)*grad(R) - sin(poloidal_angle)*grad(Z) + cos(poloidal_angle)*sin(toroidal_angle)*grad(Phi)/norm(grad(Phi))
traced.given_segment: a bound probe source states the value is the normal-axis component averaged over the sensor volume
traced.drops_segment: the definition states a point component of the local induction along the toroidal direction

traced.name: poloidal_angle_of_flux_surface
traced.evidence_excerpt: Poloidal angle of the sensitive axis orientation
traced.evidence_text: description: Poloidal angle of the sensitive axis orientation of a poloidal field (Bp) probe coil, defining its alignment relative to the poloidal direction. Used together with the toroidal angle to fully specify the coil orientation in 3D space.
traced.given_segment: a bound magnetics source states the angle is the coil's sensitive-axis orientation
traced.drops_segment: the name and definition make it a spatial angle on a flux surface about the magnetic axis

traced.name: vertical_coordinate_of_measurement_position
traced.evidence_excerpt: Average position of the measurements derived from multiple collectors
traced.evidence_text: langmuir_probes/reciprocating/plunge/position_average: Average position of the measurements derived from multiple collectors
traced.given_segment: a bound collector source states the position is the average of several collector signals
traced.drops_segment: the definition makes it a single pointwise projection and excludes averaging

repair.smallest: Bind the locus to the selection the source states: in the naming rules, reserve _of_/_at_plasma_boundary for a source that names the LCFS, and require a qualifier for a selected boundary (psi_norm = 0.99 or near-separatrix) or a vocab_gap when the grammar has no such qualifier; the documentation stage then inherits the selection instead of the registry's categorical LCFS.
repair.note: The registry definition of plasma_boundary lives in imas_standard_names and is not edited here; the repair is the codex-side rule that decides when that token is the right identity.

traced.name: elongation_of_plasma_boundary
traced.evidence_excerpt: typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.evidence_text: equilibrium/time_slice/boundary: Description of the plasma boundary used by fixed-boundary codes and typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.given_segment: the enclosing equilibrium/time_slice/boundary node lets the boundary be chosen at 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.drops_segment: the name's _of_plasma_boundary resolves through the locus registry to the categorical LCFS

traced.name: lower_triangularity_of_plasma_boundary
traced.evidence_excerpt: typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.evidence_text: equilibrium/time_slice/boundary: Description of the plasma boundary used by fixed-boundary codes and typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.given_segment: the same enclosing node states the boundary is selectable
traced.drops_segment: the lower triangularity is documented on the last closed flux surface instead

traced.name: minor_radius_of_plasma_boundary
traced.evidence_excerpt: typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.evidence_text: equilibrium/time_slice/boundary: Description of the plasma boundary used by fixed-boundary codes and typically chosen at psi_norm = 99.x% of the separatrix
traced.given_segment: the enclosing node states the selectable boundary and one summary source names the LCFS
traced.drops_segment: the documentation forces the minor radius to be that of the last closed flux surface

traced.name: poloidal_magnetic_flux_at_plasma_boundary
traced.evidence_excerpt: Typically set at a near-separatrix flux surface
traced.evidence_text: description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ) at the plasma boundary surface used by fixed-boundary equilibrium codes. Typically set at a near-separatrix flux surface (psi_norm ≈ 99%) as the boundary condition for the equilibrium solution.
traced.given_segment: the equilibrium boundary-leaf source sets the boundary at a near-separatrix surface (psi_norm about 0.99)
traced.drops_segment: the name's _at_plasma_boundary makes the boundary the last closed flux surface

causes.same_repair_why: The same lineage-and-leaf text repair reaches the composer; the qualifier then needs a registered token or a vocab_gap.
The text repair puts the coordinate convention in front of the composer, but choosing the right convention token is a separate rule.
Vacuum is a source-contribution qualifier carried in the enclosing statement; the text repair makes it visible and the prompt already requires preservation.
The pedestal top is a registered locus the enumerable vocabulary already offers; the name loses it because the enclosing text naming the pedestal is not rendered.
A definition-stage rule: the definition must state the named transform or derivative rather than substitute a base quantity.
The text repair exposes the averaging clause; expressing it needs the aggregation token or prefix the grammar provides, and a rule binding them.
Same stage and the same 'bind the source-stated selection' repair shape, but the selection is signed-minimum versus minimum-of-absolute, not the boundary kind.
The text repair exposes thermal-versus-total; the subject segment must carry it, which is a token-selection rule.
A definition-stage rule: the definition may not substitute a different geometric or coordinate scope for the source's.
The same repair: the source's stated branch or point-selection rule outranks the generic template.
The domain stage resolves a domain from the sources' DD domains; a structural quantity reached only through an equilibrium consumer needs its own domain source.
